_comment: artifact.c touch_artifact() 951-962: a wished-for cross-aligned intelligent artifact blasts the hero through losehp(), and an accepted death enters done() and never returns, so invent.c hold_another_object() prints no 'x - <artifact>.' line and zap.c makewish() adds no prayer timeout. A lawful Valkyrie wishes for Stormbringer, is killed by its blast, answers y to 'Die?' and skips the disclosure. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
